quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText0: Oh, how wonderful! This note is just what I needed.$h#$b#I can't wait to find this egg and welcome a new friend to my farm. Thank you so much for your help!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText1: What delightful news! This information will be so helpful.$h#$b#I'm excited to go find this egg and expand my farm. Thanks a bunch for thinking of me!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText2: Fantastic! This note is perfect. I'll head out to find this egg right away.$h#$b#It's always a joy to add a new member to my farm. I really appreciate your assistance!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText3: Oh, that's marvelous! This note will guide me to the egg, and I can't wait to see what hatches.$h#$b#Thank you for being so thoughtful and helping me grow my farm!$h#$b#
